generation.finalPrompts: The prompt field on each board identifies the final generation/edit step; v1/prompts retains supporting prompt history.

components.name: Floating navigation
components.purpose: Preserve recognizable navigation and the unchanged full-color logo; keep one clear contact action.
components.behavior: Logo returns home; active route is selected; Core Agentic opens a concise menu including Trust & Control; language selector preserves the current route.

components.name: Headline and actions
components.purpose: Establish what Core Agentic does in one glance.
components.behavior: Primary: Talk to our team → /contact. Secondary: Explore use cases → /use-cases. Headline stays real HTML text during implementation.

components.name: Connected work illustration
components.purpose: Show a request, configured agent roles, approved systems and a reviewable output.
components.behavior: Illustrative marketing diagram. Animated routes are optional; all meaning remains visible when motion is disabled.

components.name: Control cues
components.purpose: Introduce approved knowledge, human oversight and visible execution.
components.behavior: Link the cue group to /trust; icons accompany text and do not carry meaning alone.

components.name: Operational bottlenecks
components.purpose: Make scattered information, repeated work and coordination costs recognizable.
components.behavior: Three informative cards; no compulsory click or carousel. Stack on mobile.

boards.title: Homepage — business value and use cases

components.name: Business-value hierarchy
components.purpose: Prioritize productivity and economics, with agility, accuracy and transparency supporting them.
components.behavior: Copy describes intended outcomes; measured claims require their own evidence.

components.name: Illustrative effort comparison
components.purpose: Explain a 100-minute baseline becoming 60 human minutes after assistance, including review.
components.behavior: Use the pictured comparison table: before 60 eligible + 40 other + 0 added review = 100; assisted 12 remaining + 40 other + 8 review = 60. The result is 40% less human effort.

components.name: Economics link
components.purpose: Move interested buyers to the full model.
components.behavior: Explore the economics → /business-value. Treat recovered capacity and total financial savings separately.

components.name: Use-case tabs
components.purpose: Let visitors recognize relevant work without reading every application.
components.behavior: Tabs: Inbound sales, Outbound research, Internal operations, Research & knowledge. Internal operations is the pictured selection.

components.name: Scenario and output
components.purpose: Connect a specific request to sources, agent contribution, human review and an output.
components.behavior: Illustrative workflow label stays visible; Explore this use case opens the equivalent section on /use-cases.

boards.title: Homepage — delivery, platform, company and closing

components.name: Delivery overview
components.purpose: Explain how a business problem becomes a working proof and then an operating capability.
components.behavior: Six stages link to /how-we-work; the working-session CTA goes to /contact with inquiry intent, without invented duration or price.

components.name: Preparation card
components.purpose: Make the first engagement concrete.
components.behavior: Show process owner, approved data and success measures; no sensitive file-upload request on the public form.

components.name: Platform explanation
components.purpose: Substantiate the business story with knowledge, orchestration, workflows, connections and controls.
components.behavior: Keep authoritative systems separate. Explore the platform → /core-agentic.

components.name: Execution concept
components.purpose: Show user-visible steps and review points.
components.behavior: Label as concept preview with sample data. This is not an authentic product screenshot or a disclosure of hidden model reasoning.

components.name: Founder-story bridge
components.purpose: Connect practical experience to the productivity mission.
components.behavior: Our story → /company. Use real approved portraits only during implementation.

components.name: Closing invitation
components.purpose: Invite a useful conversation after the business story.
components.behavior: Talk to our team → /contact. Avoid guaranteed competitive outcomes.

components.name: Footer
components.purpose: Provide platform, application, company and policy navigation.
components.behavior: Use approved contact details only; keep other products secondary according to their actual commercial role.

components.name: Platform introduction and anchors
components.purpose: Orient a technical evaluator without losing the business context.
components.behavior: Anchor links scroll to sections with header offset; selected anchor uses text and underline as well as color.

components.name: Architecture graph
components.purpose: Show the orchestrator selecting knowledge, workflows, tools and configured agents under shared controls.
components.behavior: Include result and clarification feedback. Do not represent agents as arbitrary workflow nodes or show unlimited authority.

components.name: Orchestration story
components.purpose: Explain goal understanding, capability selection, result inspection and clarification.
components.behavior: An illustrative order-review example; availability depends on configured and qualified capabilities.

components.name: Activity preview
components.purpose: Make planning narration, tool activity and review state understandable.
components.behavior: Use the Concept preview · sample data label. Replace with a qualified real screenshot when the exact scenario is verified.

components.name: Knowledge and source trail
components.purpose: Connect organizational relationships to inspectable source evidence.
components.behavior: Source revision and access boundaries remain meaningful; graph grounding does not guarantee correctness.

components.name: Business-value introduction
components.purpose: Explain the evaluation basis: accepted output, effort, quality and total cost.
components.behavior: Use no unverified headline performance number.

components.name: Model inputs
components.purpose: Make assumptions editable and visible.
components.behavior: Baseline 100 min; eligible share 60%; AI-handled eligible work 80%; review 8 min. Every slider also has a keyboard-operable numeric field.

components.name: Modeled result
components.purpose: Translate assumptions into understandable human effort.
components.behavior: 100 × (1 − .60 × .80) + 8 = 60 minutes. 40% less human effort. Label illustrative, not a product result.

components.name: Effort comparison table
components.purpose: Make the baseline and assisted effort directly comparable without relying on raster chart proportions.
components.behavior: Exact rows: eligible work 60/12 min; other work 40/40 min; added review 0/8 min; total 100/60 min. Keep semantic table headers and readable units.

components.name: Full-cost section
components.purpose: Include implementation, platform, usage, operations and support in the evaluation.
components.behavior: Cost assumptions are optional. Do not assume released hours are payroll reductions; avoid counting the same value twice.

components.name: Evidence distinctions
components.purpose: Separate research, models and measured implementation evidence.
components.behavior: Each research claim needs its study context; each customer result needs baseline, scope, period and permission.

components.name: Application navigation
components.purpose: Help buyers select a recognizable job.
components.behavior: Use tabs with keyboard arrows on desktop; a clear selector or stacked navigation on narrow screens.

components.name: Concrete scenario
components.purpose: Explain the starting task and intended reviewable outcome.
components.behavior: Keep the illustrative-workflow label and exact evidence status.

components.name: Work and human responsibilities
components.purpose: Distinguish agent contribution from team accountability.
components.behavior: Retrieve → analyze → prepare → human review. Consequential system changes require applicable policy and authorization.

components.name: Output concept
components.purpose: Show what the team will receive.
components.behavior: Readable operations-review sections without fictional customer statistics; conceptual output is clearly labeled.

components.name: Prerequisites and measures
components.purpose: Make feasibility and evaluation discussable.
components.behavior: Information needed, controls to agree, measures of success; inquiry CTA carries selected use-case context.

boards.title: How We Work — working proof to operation

components.name: Working-proof invitation
components.purpose: Offer a focused path from a valuable bottleneck to evidence.
components.behavior: Plan a working session → /contact. Scope, preparation and terms are agreed; no automatic free or five-day offer.

components.name: Working brief
components.purpose: Show what the customer helps define.
components.behavior: Process, owner, approved data and success measures are preparation prompts, not a data-upload interface.

components.name: Delivery stages
components.purpose: Set expectations for proof, evaluation, operation and expansion.
components.behavior: Proceed, refine or stop is an explicit evaluation decision. A successful proof is not the same as a qualified production release.

components.name: Workforce enablement
components.purpose: Make practical AI literacy part of adoption.
components.behavior: Useful instructions, verification, sensitive information, permissions and escalation; role-specific learning.

components.name: Shared responsibility and inquiry
components.purpose: Clarify who contributes and what happens next.
components.behavior: Customer supplies process knowledge and business validation; Primitive AI supplies agreed platform and implementation work.

components.name: Trust introduction
components.purpose: Explain authority in concrete terms.
components.behavior: Access, action and decision rights are configured for the user and use case.

components.name: Control principles
components.purpose: Make approved access, consequential actions and visible work easy to assess.
components.behavior: Use precise examples without certification or compliance promises.

components.name: Approval concept
components.purpose: Show the actual change and decision point a person should inspect.
components.behavior: Concept preview only. Real implementation must bind approval to the exact action and respect cancel/reject semantics.

components.name: Authority progression
components.purpose: Show how responsibility can expand deliberately.
components.behavior: Read; prepare; execute with approval; act within policy. This is not a compulsory automation ladder or access grant.

components.name: Deployment questions
components.purpose: Identify choices agreed during solution design.
components.behavior: Identity, retention, models, hosting and operational ownership. Confirm supported choices before publication.

components.name: Company mission
components.purpose: Establish Primitive AI's purpose and practical focus.
components.behavior: Generic contextual imagery must not be represented as a real customer site.

components.name: Founding question
components.purpose: Give the productivity mission personal meaning.
components.behavior: Present as the founder's conviction rather than an economic research finding.

components.name: Learning and product journey
components.purpose: Connect education, practical AI, response quality, knowledge research and Core Agentic.
components.behavior: 2016 is the confirmed learning year. Avoid invented launch dates and role chronology.

components.name: Operating principles and invitation
components.purpose: Connect mission to practical company behavior.
components.behavior: Augment people, use existing systems, measure useful outcomes. Links to platform and delivery pages.

components.name: Contact invitation
components.purpose: Ask about an organizational problem rather than a generic technology purchase.
components.behavior: Explain that the first discussion assesses fit and a possible working session.

components.name: What happens next
components.purpose: Reduce uncertainty and prepare a useful conversation.
components.behavior: Process understanding, data/technical fit, scoped next step; no unconfirmed response-time promise.

components.name: Core inquiry fields
components.purpose: Collect only the information needed to respond.
components.behavior: Name, work email, organization and workflow description. Persistent visible labels; do not use placeholder text as the label.

components.name: Optional context
components.purpose: Let a prepared buyer add systems and task frequency without burdening everyone.
components.behavior: Optional fields stay optional. Preserve input through validation errors.

components.name: Validation and receipt states
components.purpose: Define focus, error and success behavior before implementation.
components.behavior: The strip is a design study, not a simultaneous live form state. Show receipt only after a real server or service accepts the submission.

boards.title: Mobile — homepage, value, use case and menu

components.name: Mobile header and hero
components.purpose: Preserve the headline and main decision in a narrow layout.
components.behavior: Full-color logo on light capsule; open menu; two stacked actions; 44–48 px hit areas.

components.name: Simplified diagram and sticky action
components.purpose: Reflow meaning rather than shrinking desktop art.
components.behavior: Request → Core Agentic → approved systems → reviewable result. Sticky action respects safe area and never covers content.

components.name: Mobile economics
components.purpose: Keep assumptions and results readable.
components.behavior: The mobile worksheet uses the same four assumptions as desktop: baseline 100 min, eligible share 60%, AI-handled eligible share 80%, added review 8 min. The displayed assisted total is 60 min, including review.

components.name: Mobile use-case detail
components.purpose: Let users understand the scenario and human checkpoints.
components.behavior: Vertical steps, disclosure for sources/controls, clear contextual CTA.

components.name: Full-height navigation
components.purpose: Provide complete route and language access.
components.behavior: Visible close button, Escape support, focus trap while open, restore focus to trigger, correct scroll locking and safe areas.

notes: The selected main interface blue is #044EFF; original logo artwork remains unchanged.
All preview interfaces are concepts, not actual product captures.
The manifest prompt field identifies the final used generation/edit prompt. Earlier prompts remain as process history.
